in_marathi.name: Mohanbhai
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mohanbhai हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mohan is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'mohana', which means to 'delight' or 'charm'. The prefix 'bhai' means 'brother'. Thus, Mohanbhai can be interpreted as the 'brave brother of the moon'.
